engineering_disposition: promising_factory_candidate; station coverage and capacity checks required

product.material: zinc-plated structural steel; exact grade to be frozen from product record

applicability.published_capacity_basis: EN 912 connector classification plus applicable timber-code calculation; product page states 2.5 N/mm2 maximum compression in the pressed surfaces for solid wood
applicability.capacity_for_this_board: unresolved; requires density, bolt grade, plate/washer stack, grain direction, edge/end distances, and combined-action check
applicability.custom_steel_required: not for a basic paired-side-plate/double-shear detail, but station geometry is not yet proven

development_constraints: Use only a double-shear wood-to-wood detail with paired bearing plates or the exact approved hardware stack.
Do not treat the 2.5 N/mm2 pressed-surface limit as a complete joint capacity.
The 50 mm connector diameter and bolt axis must be checked against every station's edge and end reserves.
No native solve, drilling schedule, or purchase release is authorized from this screen alone.
decision: Advance C1 to bounded representative-joint geometry and resistance screening. It is a better semantic match than AB90 for a removable through-bolted wood-to-wood joint, but it is not yet accepted for the MoonBoard frame.
